meta.title: Image Brightness & Contrast Adjuster - Edit Photos Online
meta.subtitle: Easily adjust the lighting and contrast of your photos online.
meta.desc: Adjust brightness and contrast of your photos online. Fix underexposed images or add pop to dull photos easily for free.

input.title: Adjust Image Brightness & Contrast
input.desc: Upload your photo to instantly correct lighting and colors.

content.title: Online Brightness & Contrast Editor
content.p1: Perfect your photos by adjusting the lighting balance. Our tool allows you to easily brighten dark photos or increase contrast to make colors pop.
content.p2: Whether you have an underexposed shot or a flat-looking image, you can fix it in seconds without installing complex photo editing software.

lighting.title: Fix Lighting
lighting.desc: Brighten shadows and underexposed areas to reveal hidden details.

pop.title: Add Pop
pop.desc: Increase contrast to make your images look sharper and more vibrant.

instant.title: Instant Preview
instant.desc: See adjustments in real-time as you move the sliders.

how_to.title: How to Adjust Brightness & Contrast
list: Use the 'Brightness' slider to clamp light levels.
Use the 'Contrast' slider to adjust the difference between light and dark areas.
Click 'Download' to save your edited photo.
